acceptance_profile.aggregation: Exact per-window and per-condition scalar metrics; no cross-condition averaging, tolerance widening or provider substitution.
acceptance_profile.corpus: frozen seeded synthetic signals only; no external corpus, model, WAV or download

bundle_validation.rule: Adapter responses for both requests must match the checked-in report row on status, metrics, missing_results and qualifies.

candidate_settings.algorithm: causal samplewise NLMS on explicit render reference
candidate_settings.hold_note: Instantaneous hold disabled: pinned research showed sharp ERLE loss; no detector is proposed.

historical_fixed_hybrid.cohort: 12 paired real AEC Challenge training groups, non-blind, rights unresolved
historical_fixed_hybrid.configuration: fixed 128-tap RLS-to-NLMS hybrid, no freeze/limiter added
historical_fixed_hybrid.interpretation: Echo attenuation can coexist with severe near-end degradation and instability; no fixed-hybrid family claim follows.

controls.separation: ERLE windows, near preservation and fixed controls are reported in separate fields; fixed/identity rows never qualify.

synthetic_fixed_hybrid_replay.note: Oracle-gated fixed gain replay on the frozen synthetic fixture; not a replay of the pinned real-recording scores.

rationale: Only seeded synthetic paired signals and analytic echo paths are measured.
No licensed recorded render/capture, clean near speech, AECMOS, ASR or listening evidence exists here.
No measured loop gain, target-device timing, deadline or resource result exists here.
Provider, license and catalog intake has not been performed.

excitation.near_end: independent analytic harmonic/syllable source, no corpus (seed 20261125)

missing_far_end_only_window.reason: near-only render cannot yield an ERLE window

missing_near_reference.reason: no clean near-end reference for this stratum

mdf_limitation_disclosure.note: The merged MDF reference measured higher ERLE on a one-frame misaligned render than on the aligned render, and its small-overlap near-ratio window contains residual echo. ERLE is not an alignment detector and overlap near-ratio is not a double-talk quality result.

mutable_provenance.note: Mutable board snapshot read at implementation time; provenance only, never a qualification gate.

non_claims: No real recording, room impulse response, measured device buffer or clock drift.
No AECMOS, ASR word accuracy, MOS, pystoi production scorer or authorized listening result.
No loudspeaker/microphone loop, loop gain or gain-before-feedback measurement.
No target-device CPU, memory, pacing, deadline or availability timing.
No SDK processor, provider registration, descriptor, catalog entry, default or installed-v0 change.
No historical source-reported score is reproduced or treated as local evidence.
No Tiny16 comparison was run; there is no S10/protocol clearance, approved independent reference adapter or permitted case manifest here.
ERLE does not validate render alignment; see mdf_limitation_disclosure.

qualification.rule: A row qualifies only when its status is ok and every applicable ERLE and near-preservation metric is present; missing or withheld results force qualifies=false.

release_gates: Paired licensed render/capture recordings with pinned provenance, hashes, sample alignment and measured render latency; rights and participant-use terms resolved before use.
AECMOS echo and degradation scores, ASR word accuracy and authorized listening on real speech, with double-talk/near-only/path-change strata and clean near references where permitted.
Measured loudspeaker/microphone loop gain and gain-before-feedback, plus target-device buffer, clock-drift, content delay, p50/p95 compute, memory and deadline measurements.
Provider/license/catalog intake: SPDX/REUSE review, opt-in provider kept OFF by default and unregistered until approved, descriptor and public-catalog review, and no installed-v0 behavior change.

repeat_runs.note: Canonical digests of the report core without repeat_runs; verify.py also performs three byte-identical CLI regenerations.
